impact: A `font-family: Roboto` with no weight suffix resolves to Regular even when the SVG's editor intended Bold. Silent — user sees a rendered result that looks off but doesn't know why. Surface a warning row in the missing-fonts list.
resolution: Committed in 5a7e7b1. Added `weightExplicit` to the parseFamily return object; fetchFontAsBase64 threads it through; main.js appends "weight 400 assumed (add \"-Bold\" if you meant Bold)" to the auto-resolved report line only when the family name carried no recognisable weight suffix. So "Roboto-Bold", "OpenSans SemiBold", "Times-BoldMT" all stay quiet — the warning fires only for bare "Roboto" and equivalents. Tests updated to assert the new field across 5 shapes. All 27 tests still green.
title: Ambiguous font-family names silently default to weight 400
